stepStart: Starting matrix: no operation has been done yet.
noSteps: This matrix is already in the requested form: no operation is needed.
opScale: Multiply a row by a non-zero number
opAdd: Add a multiple of another row to a row
pivotNote: The pivots, the first non-zero number of each non-zero row, are highlighted.
rankSub: The rank is the number of non-zero rows of the echelon form: {r}.
rankBound: The rank never exceeds min({m}, {n}) = {k}, the smaller of the two sizes.
detZero: The determinant is 0: A has no inverse.
detNonZero: The determinant is not 0: A has an inverse.
inverseFound: The left part has reached the identity and the right part is A⁻¹.
inverseCheckBad: Check: A · A⁻¹ does not give I.
noInvNotSquare: A is {m} × {n}: only square matrices can have an inverse.
noInvRank: rank(A) = {r} is less than {n}: a row of zeros is left on the left, so A has no inverse.
planeTitle: What A does to the plane
planeAria: Unit square and its image under the matrix A
planeColumns: The columns of A are the images of the vectors e₁ = (1, 0) and e₂ = (0, 1).
planeArea: Signed area of the image = det(A) = {d}.
planeFlip: The determinant is negative: the figure is flipped over.
planeFull: rank(A) = 2: the plane is not flattened and the square, which had area 1, now has area {a}.
planeSegment: rank(A) = 1: the whole plane is flattened onto a line, the square becomes a segment and its area is 0.
planePoint: rank(A) = 0: the whole plane is flattened onto the origin and the square becomes a point.
